empoweringEducation.title: Empowering Education & Community Growth
body: We are dedicated to empowering the students of La Argentina through key initiatives that address critical gaps in education and community infrastructure.

From building a much-needed library and restoring a vital soccer field to providing scholarships for higher education, our mission is to create opportunities that inspire learning, foster unity, and open doors for future generations.
empoweringEducation.alt: A woman and a child reading outside beside a stack of books

culture.title: Fostering a Culture
body: Educational disparities persist in Colombia, particularly in rural areas. As of 2024, only 55% of young people aged 17 to 21 access higher education, significantly below the OECD average of 70%. This gap is even more pronounced in remote regions, where students often face limited access to quality educational resources.
culture.commitmentsIntro: At MOCA Colombia, we are committed to bridging these educational gaps in La Argentina through targeted initiatives:
commitments: Infrastructure development: Constructing and enhancing educational facilities, including libraries and classrooms, to create conducive learning environments.
Scholarship programs: Providing financial assistance to students, enabling them to pursue higher education and vocational training.
Community engagement: Collaborating with local leaders and organizations to promote the value of education and encourage community involvement in school activities.
